description.value:
You are always accompanied by a loyal follower, a retainer who has sworn to fight and die for your cause. They have the minion trait and begin as a novice follower.

Use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H72AAzknXiojqXdY] to command your follower. Your follower's level equals yours, and their tier advances through your court's features at 4th, 8th and 14th level.

Setup (PF2e Companion Compendia): create a character actor for your follower, add the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.mefI4QYwzSIQiwGj] ancestry and one follower type: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Followers.Item.A4lRasm15Gtkhj9G], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Followers.Item.UGypwzL2kf2lpvGK], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Followers.Item.ZgVoPylxwZuz9B4k], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Followers.Item.BrQt3St9A9ntCRus], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Followers.Item.qexqlVIb13Z8Yub6], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Followers.Item.HO6R7mNIBU6LgJpo].
